style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern school science fair question-and-answer session. Confident child presenter stands beside a simple working water-filtration model and fluently answers a panel of three adults who each ask different questions shown ONLY as small pictorial bubbles: dirty water, layers of sand and gravel, clear water droplets. Child has open speaking mouth, calm steady eyes and natural explanatory hand gesture toward the corresponding model layers. Several short flowing colored lines connect each question picture to its matching part of model, conveying quick coherent answers, no written words or question marks. Adults listen with impressed smiles, one nods while another is asking. Child answering successive questions, not giving a one-way memorized speech. Physically sound filter mounted above collecting jar, water flows down through gravel and sand to jar, no impossible plumbing. Natural two arms five fingers, stable table and proper contact. 3:2 landscape, pencil watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no logos labels letters numbers watermarks.
alt: 科展學生從容回答評審接連提出的濾水問題，一邊說明、一邊指向模型的不同濾層，評審微笑點頭。
